jobs.title: [Job-32675] Dynamics 365 CRM Senior Software Developer, Colombia
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We’re looking for a Dynamics 365 CRM Software Developer to join a dedicated nearshore team building a placement management platform for a US education client. The CRM core runs on Dynamics 365 and Dataverse, integrated with Azure services and a React frontend. You’ll build and extend the CRM layer and the Azure components around it.

What you’ll do
Customize Dynamics 365 and Dataverse: tables (entities), forms, views, business rules and Power Automate flows.
Develop C# plugins and custom workflow logic, following Dynamics best practices for performance and upgrades.
Configure Dataverse security, including security roles, business units, teams and field-level security.
Build Azure Function Apps that integrate with Dataverse, managed in Azure DevOps repos and deployed through Azure DevOps pipelines.
Work in an Agile team, overlapping with US Central Time.

What we’re looking for
Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse development, with production delivery.
Strong C# / .NET skills, including plugin development and the Dataverse SDK or Web API.
Practical experience with core Azure resources and concepts, especially Function Apps, plus CI/CD in Azure DevOps.
Experience managing solutions and moving them across environments (ALM).
Upper-intermediate or advanced English for daily communication with US stakeholders.

Nice to have
Experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Customer Insights – Journeys or Contact Center.
PCF components or Power Apps portals / Power Pages.
Certifications such as PL-400 (Power Platform Developer), MB-910 or AZ-204.

And many others.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team

Netlify's engineering teams build the products, platforms, and infrastructure that empower millions of developers and builders to create, deploy, and scale modern web applications. From AI-powered workflows to edge infrastructure and developer experience, our engineering teams tackle challenges that directly shape how modern web applications are built and deployed. We’re hiring engineers at the senior and staff levels across multiple teams, spanning AI runners and workflow orchestration, accounts and billing, growth, developer experience, and platform engineering across compute, edge infrastructure, build systems, and observability. On our Experience team, we’re rethinking how people and agents interact with Netlify through our CLI, SDK, and APIs as more of our users arrive through agents.

We're looking for thoughtful, full-stack engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. As an engineer at Netlify, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers who care about building great software, sharing knowledge, and helping one another grow. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions.

With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

What You'll Do

- Use your expertise in full-stack development (Our stack is TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Ruby, and Go) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite.

- Build and maintain user-facing features, product APIs, and platform capabilities that scale to support millions of developers worldwide and lead projects from conception to delivery

- Apply strong engineering fundamentals, including testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization, while thoughtfully incorporating AI-assisted development tools to accelerate prototyping, experimentation, and delivery.

- Navigate ambiguity with curiosity, contributing to both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly improve the developer experience and business outcomes.

- Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly.

- Participate in code reviews, on-call rotations, and continuous improvement efforts to reduce technical debt and maintain high engineering standards.

- Collaborate regularly with Engineering, Product, Design, and cross-functional teammates to design and implement experiences that help developers build faster and more effectively.

- Partner with teammates to share knowledge, mentor others through collaboration, and contribute to a thoughtful, inclusive engineering culture where continuous learning is encouraged.

What You'll Bring

- Demonstrated engineering proficiency with a curiosity for building with new technologies

- Strong full-stack expertise, with experience developing and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments. Required familiarity with one of the following: TypeScript and JavaScript, Go or Ruby for backend services and API development. Broader familiarity preferred.

- Extensive production experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases.

- Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time.

- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, GPT-based agents, or similar technologies) to build applications, improve engineering workflows, or accelerate software development, along with good judgment about when and how to apply them effectively.

- Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges.

- Ability to participate in an on-call rotation after onboarding, responding primarily to scaling and reliability incidents using established runbooks.

- A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader company goals.

- Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices.

- Passion for working in a collaborative environment with teammates across distributed locations, and strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments.

This Role is a Great Fit If

- You're energized by building products and platform capabilities that help millions of developers create, deploy, and scale applications.

- You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and enjoy solving problems where there isn't always a predefined path forward.

- You see AI as a multiplier for your engineering skills - not a shortcut - and can thoughtfully articulate where it adds value, where it doesn't, and how you use it responsibly.

- You enjoy owning problems from end to end and are motivated by opportunities to make meaningful technical and product decisions.

- Comfort working autonomously and making decisions within a distributed, async, remote-first team.

- You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first.

- You value curiosity, continuous learning, and creating an environment where teammates can learn from one another and do their best work.

- You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, inclusion, and building a better web, together.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Remote LATAM)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.

Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.

AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

- Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

- Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

- Great Place to Work Certified™

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own the end-to-end product development lifecycle of identifying, designing, and shipping large initiatives for clients and advisors.

- Produce high-quality, production-ready, readable, maintainable code

- Work cross-functionally with product leadership, design, and business partners to deliver the best product.

MUST HAVE:

- 5-10 years building web applications with experience shipping features in production environments

- Full-stack development skills including web frameworks (Rails preferred), TypeScript, frontend frameworks and libraries (Next.js and React preferred), and SQL databases

- Experience writing automated tests across the stack (unit, integration, and end-to-end, e.g. RSpec, Vitest, Playwright) and treating tests as part of shipping a feature, not a follow-up

- Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow, including reviewing and testing AI-generated code with the same rigor as your own

- Strong collaboration and communication working effectively in cross-functional teams with clear technical communication skills

- Understanding of web application fundamentals including authentication/authorization, caching, background processing, and API design principles (GraphQL preferred)

NICE TO HAVE:

- Fintech domain knowledge including financial services, wealth management, regulatory compliance, or financial data integrations

- Modern development ecosystem experience with macOS toolchains, CI/CD pipelines, IaaS providers, and observability platforms (Datadog)

BENEFITS:

- Competitive salary and equity package

- We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

- Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

- Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

- Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans

- NYC office in Union Square

- Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

- Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

- Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

- Benefits are available to full-time employees

jobs.description:

Senior Full Stack Engineer

Job Family/Job Family Group: Engineering / Technology

Job Level: Senior

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll lead the design, architecture, and implementation of high-throughput data integration pipelines that connect critical internal systems and external partner data sources to our core platform. Operating across modern backend ecosystems and data platforms, you will be responsible for defining technical patterns, standards, and scalable ingestion workflows that enable repeatable, resilient integrations across an expanding ecosystem of tools and applications.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, self-organized, and resilient—a technical leader who excels at translating complex functional requirements into clear, manageable solutions while mentoring cross-functional peers and upholding rigorous technical documentation standards.

Responsibilities:

• Architect and implement robust, production-grade Python extraction tools that interface with partner APIs, expertly managing authentication, pagination, error handling, rate limits, and data reliability at scale.

• Design and manage end-to-end ingestion pipelines to write extracted data directly into the cloud data warehouse in alignment with established architectural patterns.

• Define data models adhering to platform standards, ensuring processed data is structured for accessibility, integrity, and consistent consumption across client-facing interfaces and reporting layers.

• Implement and maintain SQL transformation logic using dbt to bridge the gap between raw source data structures and the presentation layer, adhering to industry best practices and convention.

• Standardize and document integration workflows, producing comprehensive guides and technical blueprints to make integration repeatable across multiple partner applications.

• Lead technical design discussions , breaking down ambiguous, large-scale problems into actionable milestones and actionable technical sub-tasks.

• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, product, and data stakeholders to ensure unified data governance, reliability, and security compliance.

• Optimize and monitor platform pipeline performance, driving root-cause analysis for edge-case integration failures and continuously refining error-recovery protocols.

About You

The essentials:

• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience across the full development lifecycle.

• Expert Python proficiency , with demonstrated history in building production-grade API clients, custom data pipelines, and scalable backend services.

• Advanced data warehousing experience , including schema design, modeling, and loading into platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, or Google BigQuery.

• Deep proficiency with dbt and SQL , including building modular, testable transformation workflows and maintaining clean data lineage.

• Proven track record consuming and integrating complex third-party and internal RESTful APIs, with expertise in resilient error handling and distributed systems.

• Demonstrated leadership in a senior individual contributor or tech lead capacity, driving data integration workstreams and defining architectural standards.

• Excellent problem-solving and documentation skills , with the ability to clearly structure discussions, gather stakeholder requirements, and maintain detailed engineering specs.

• Fluent professional English (written and verbal), required for everyday collaboration across distributed, international teams.

Not a Must but a Plus:

• Hands-on experience with modern data orchestration tools , such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

• Experience across modern frontend web frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript, Vue) alongside core backend and data capabilities.

• Background in partner API ecosystem scaling or developing reusable SDKs/connector libraries.

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Art

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

THE OPPORTUNITY

- Make web development faster by improving builds, type checking, linting, and tests, both locally and in CI

- Evolve our monorepo, package management, and shared configuration so changes across applications and libraries are straightforward and reliable

- Simplify development environment setup and support parallel work by engineers and coding agents, with clear documentation and tools that work with minimal configuration

- Improve web delivery pipelines, including preview environments, progressive rollouts, production monitoring, and reliable rollback

- Strengthen automated validation, including browser-based checks that help engineers and agents verify changes before they ship

- Work with product and infrastructure teams to investigate web performance, improve observability, and address problems across application code, tooling, and delivery

- Lead tooling upgrades and migrations across teams, balancing long-term improvements with the practical needs of engineers shipping products

- Own improvements from design through rollout and ongoing maintenance, staying close to the people using what you build

WHAT YOU BRING

- Solid experience building and maintaining production web applications, with a strong understanding of React and the modern JavaScript ecosystem

- Strong TypeScript and JavaScript skills, including experience using Node.js to build tooling and automation

- A good understanding of how web applications work, including browser behavior, module systems, bundling, caching, and performance

- Experience improving developer tooling, build systems, automated testing, or CI/CD pipelines, and the ability to diagnose problems across those layers

- Good judgment about reliability, security, maintainability, and when added complexity is worth the cost

- The ability to lead a technical design, explain it clearly, and work with other teams to get changes adopted

- Ownership: you can take an ambiguous problem, find a practical solution, and keep it working once people depend on it

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience maintaining large monorepos, shared packages, or tooling used by multiple engineering teams

- Familiarity with pnpm, ESM, and modern build, linting, and test tools

- Experience with browser automation, end-to-end testing, web performance profiling, or production observability

- Hands-on experience with coding agents and improving the environments, documentation, and feedback loops they rely on

- Experience with GitLab CI, containers, or cloud infrastructure supporting web development and delivery

- Contributions to open-source frontend infrastructure or developer tools

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

What you'll do

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

- Architect, build, and maintain features related to digital assets across MetaMask Clients, including ERC-20 tokens, NFTs, Token Lists, and Token Detail Pages

- Develop and support core wallet controllers that manage asset state and data throughout the MetaMask ecosystem

- Expand asset support to include emerging standards such as Real World Assets (RWAs)

- Help create intuitive, efficient, and secure Web3 interactions that delight users

- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality features

- Participate in code reviews and help maintain high code quality standards

Requirements:

- 3+ years working with mobile-based technologies

- 3+ years building websites and/or applications

- Experience with React and React Native

- Strong knowledge of modern Javascript (ES6/TypeScript/etc.)

- Familiarity with blockchain fundamentals and Web3 integration

- Working knowledge of cross platform/browser compatibility

- Experience working with APIs and middleware services

- Experience working in an agile development team

- Experience developing applications with clean code practices, testing, and adherence to coding standards

- Understanding of web-based security considerations

Bonus Points:

- Experience with token standards (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, RWAs) and token list management

- Experience with DeFi protocols, token swaps, or fiat on/off ramps

- Knowledge of financial products in the digital space

- Interest in blockchain technologies and Web3

- Basic understanding of cryptography principles

- Experience working in distributed teams

- Previous experience working in Web3

- Familiarity with the Web3 wallet ecosystem

- Experience with performance optimization

Other skills to demonstrate:

- Good verbal and written communication in English

- Teamwork, flexibility, and organization

- Eagerness to learn and grow your technical skills

- Ability to balance technical quality with business needs and user experience

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

$139,000 — $210,000 USD

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients. Responsibilities:

Work under the technical leadership of the Software Architect
Use agentic tools in day-to-day delivery

8+ years of experience in software engineering, at High Senior to Staff level
Strong experience with React and .NET
Hands-on use of agentic delivery pipelines in the last 1–2 years
Experience using agentic SDLC tools day to day
Good English
Based in Brazil or Colombia; fully remote, joining calls via Microsoft Teams or Google Meet

Back-end experience (full-stack profile)
